title: Topic 5.1: Commanding good and forbidding evil

pages.lesson:
LESSON: COMMANDING GOOD AND FORBIDDING EVIL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Commanding good and forbidding evil

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Commanding good and forbidding evil. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Commanding good and forbidding evil
2. Practise Commanding good and forbidding evil at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Commanding good and forbidding evil

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Commanding good and forbidding evil
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Commanding good and forbidding evil. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Commanding good and forbidding evil at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Commanding good and forbidding evil at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Commanding good and forbidding evil
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Commanding good and forbidding evil. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Commanding good and forbidding evil using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Commanding good and forbidding evil in the examples.
2. Explain Commanding good and forbidding evil to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Commanding good and forbidding evil.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Commanding good and forbidding evil using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Commanding good and forbidding evil important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Commanding good and forbidding evil
2. Practise Commanding good and forbidding evil at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Commanding good and forbidding evil

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
